item.title: Fall 2026 School of Engineering Midterm Student Course Evaluations Now Open
item.description: Date: Friday, October 9, 2026 (all day) - Fall 2026 School of Engineering (SoE) Midterm course evaluations are now open. Your feedback is very important to the Institute and the school, so please complete the SoE midterm evaluation surveys for all your courses! Evaluations will be available through Friday, October 23, 2026.

item.title: RPI Symphony Orchestra, Concert Choir, and Wind Symphony Family Weekend Concert
item.description: Celebrate Family Weekend with an afternoon of outstanding music presented by the RPI Symphony Orchestra, Concert Choir, and Wind Symphony. This exciting program features a dynamic mix of choral, wind, and orchestral works, from inspiring spirituals and majestic classics to vibrant contemporary favorites. Join us October 24, 4-5:30pm in DCC 308.

item.title: Microplastics Exhibit at Context Collective (95 4th Street, Troy)
item.description: Friday, October 23, 6-9 pm. Artist Nicole Chockrek has been collecting plastic from the environment since 2022. This installation will bring together over 30,000 pieces of plastic collected through Microplastic recycling bins (including one in Troy). Over 50 RPI faculty and students have contributed to this installation by making a microplastic mosaic. Come find your contribution, or contribute yourself!
